sentences.text: Cr. Mmo No. 1052 of 2024 16.05.2024 Present: Mr. Ashok K. Tyagi, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, learned Additional Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent and seeks time to file status report.
Be filed well before the next date of hearing.

The petitioner/accused apprehends his arrest in a case registered against him vide FIR No. 55 of 2024 dated 06.05.2024, under Section 376 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act and Sections 9 & 10 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act registered at Police Station Janjehli, District Mandi, H.P.

He, however, is directed to report to the Investigating Officer for the purpose of interrogation on 18.05.2024 at 11.00 A.M. and thereafter also as and when called upon to do so.
